Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(DataExplorer)

```

```{r}
introduce(sleep)
plot_intro(sleep)
colSums(is.na(sleep))

# A portion of our data are missing observations

sleep1 <- sleep |>
    select(-ID, -Bedtime, -'Wakeup time')

```

```{r}
plot_bar(sleep1)

# We can see from the bar plot that there are a relatively similar amount of men and women, with the majoirty of respondents not smoking
```


```{r}
plot_correlation(
  sleep1,
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
  cor_args = list("use" = "pairwise.complete.obs")
)
```


```{r}
create_report(sleep1, y = "Sleep efficiency")

# Theres a lot of info here but a few insights are that caffeine and alcohol greater reduce sleep efficiency and increase awakenings
```
